text: 你跪在垂死男子身旁时，他突然抬手抓住你的外套领子。“小心，”他嘶哑地说，“小印第安人……灰色的人。上面……他们抓走了杰克……天哪……”
他的手指松开，手臂垂落在地。他停止了呼吸。

en.title: Alone Against the Frost · 37
text: As you kneel beside the dying man, his hand shoots up and grips your jacket collar. “Beware,” he rasps. “Little Indians… Gray men. Up there… They got Jake… Oh, God…”
His fingers loosen and his arm drops to the ground. He has stopped breathing.
